schema.name: current_filters
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE "current_filters" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK("id" = 1), "rule_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'title', "descending" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("descending" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

schema.name: library_roots
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE "library_roots" ("location" TEXT NOT NULL, "accessible" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("accessible" IN (0, 1)), "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '尚未扫描', "scanned_at" INTEGER NULL, "requires_reselection" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("requires_reselection" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("location"))

schema.name: playlist_songs
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE "playlist_songs" ("playlist_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES playlists (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "song_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES songs (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("position" >= 0), PRIMARY KEY ("playlist_id", "song_id"), UNIQUE ("playlist_id", "position"))

schema.name: playlists
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE "playlists" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_key" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("kind" IN ('regular', 'smart')), "rule_json" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'title', "descending" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("descending" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

schema.name: song_locations
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE "song_locations" ("song_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES songs (id), "root" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES library_roots (location), "location" TEXT NOT NULL, "relative_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "available" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("available" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("song_id", "root"))

schema.name: song_play_counts
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE "song_play_counts" ("song_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES songs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "play_count" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("play_count" > 0), PRIMARY KEY ("song_id"))

schema.name: song_tags
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE "song_tags" ("song_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES songs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "tag_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tags (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("song_id", "tag_id"))

schema.name: songs
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE "songs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "identity" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "location" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "size" INTEGER NULL, "modified" INTEGER NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "artist" TEXT NULL, "album" TEXT NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER NULL, "metadata_error" TEXT NULL, "file_sha256" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

schema.name: tags
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE "tags" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_key" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))
